summary: Tournament mode (Classic / Time Attack / Royal) tested end to end. Backend: 14 new pytest tests (test_iter14_tournament.py) all pass, plus the full regression suite passes (267/267 serially). Frontend (375x667): home TOURNAMENT card is locked when disabled; /tournament shows the locked card and disabled mode cards. When enabled, Classic runs 20 questions with a 20s per-question countdown; a timeout auto-advances as wrong. Classic result shows the cumulative card, rank and +10 Royal, and PERINGKAT goes to the leaderboard. Time Attack uses a 90s timer, auto-finishes and shows a HIGH SCORE card with +5 Royal. Royal missions, video submit (invalid URL, success, 2nd-same-day 429) and the 3 leaderboard tabs work. Admin toggle and approve work: +20 points and a notification were checked through the API. Garuda Call quiz loads questions. Remaining issues are all minor: setState-in-render warning on Time Attack expiry, quiz not gated when tournament is closed, PERINGKAT button clipped, no trivia items in DB. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Daily-limit check (count_documents then insert) is not atomic. Concurrent like/comment/score requests can exceed daily_limit. Use a unique index on (user_id, mission, day_key, slot) or an atomic counter doc.

play_classic / play_time_attack Royal points are awarded for any submit, even score=0 or correct=0 with total<20. Nothing checks that the game was actually finished (client-trusted). Acceptable for MVP; consider requiring total==20 for t_classic.

ui_bugs.issue: onDone() (finish -> router.replace) is called inside the setRemaining updater. When the 90s Time Attack timer ends, React logs a red-box error: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component ... QuizScreen'. Also affects normal Time Attack. Fix: call onDone outside the updater, e.g. setTimeout(() => onDone?.(), 0) or a useEffect on remaining===0.

/quiz?mode=t_classic|t_time_attack does not check /tournament/status. If the tournament is disabled (deep link, or toggled mid-game), the user plays all 20 questions and only then sees 'Tournament sedang ditutup admin'. Check status on mount and show a locked state.

issues: PERINGKAT button (tournament-board-button) is too narrow at 375px: the leading icon is clipped at the left edge and the label touches the border. Use flex:1 / smaller letterSpacing or an icon-only button.
The 'Royal 👑' tab pill extends slightly to the right edge of the tab container.

action_items: Fix useCountdown: do not call onDone inside the setState updater (setState-in-render error when Time Attack expires).
Gate /quiz tournament modes on /api/tournament/status (show locked state or redirect to /tournament).
Fix PERINGKAT button clipping on the tournament result screen at 375px width.
Optional: make the award_royal daily limit atomic, and only award play_classic when a full 20-question game is submitted.
Data note: /api/quiz-items?category=trivia returns 0 items, so the Tournament mix is currently only Tebak Pemain + Garuda. Seed trivia items if a 3-way mix is expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2478 lines. The Tournament block should move to its own router module (routers/tournament.py).
Tournament scores are kept out of best_scores. Verified: the normal /api/leaderboard is unaffected.
Like no-farming works through the ref=news_id dedupe. Unlike/re-like gives 0.
Rejected videos do not count toward the daily video limit, so a user can resubmit after rejection. This looks intended; confirm.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all flows work; 1 console error on TA expiry, minor gating/design issues)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_u_* users, TEST_tok_* sessions, and TEST_nw_* news created in Mongo, then fully deleted. tournament_enabled restored to False. The real admin (user_5fad4ee9ce78) was only used for toggle/review; no tournament data was left on it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_iter14_tournament.py serially (-n 0): pytest.ini enables xdist and the tests share the global tournament toggle. For the frontend, set the token with page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('cakmad.session_token', ...)"). Setting it via evaluate+reload did not persist in the automation tool. Sessions can be inserted directly into user_sessions.
rca_of_issue: setState-in-render: useCountdown runs the onDone side effect (router.replace) inside the functional setState updater, which React runs during render. Repro: open /quiz?mode=t_time_attack&category=tournament and wait 90s; the error appears in the console and as a toast on /result.
